verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party design-tool plugin that lets a designer update Notion project status from inside the design app. The Sketch and Canva integrations go the opposite way: they show designs inside Notion. The REST API is only a developer building block that someone could use to construct such a workflow, which does not count as the capability itself.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps

citations.quote: View and share Sketch designs in Notion
